run_note: Sunday 2026-08-23, 08:20Z. NO R1 BREACH and NO SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT on either defined test. Three things lead. (1) ROOT CAUSE FOUND for the restatement fault I opened yesterday: TWO FLEET LOOP INSTANCES ARE RUNNING. Five sub-2-minute double cycles in 24h (08-22 05:50/05:51, 11:30/11:31, 17:10/17:11, 22:50/22:51, and 08-23 04:30/04:32) against a normal 13.4-minute cadence. When a trade lands inside one of those windows BOTH instances execute it at their own quote and the later write silently replaces the first. It happened again today: hypecrypto's ENA sell was written at 04:30:54Z as 0.1502 / value 940.33 and rewritten at 04:32:55Z as 0.1507 / value 943.46, moving 3.13 IN FAVOUR of the bot, where the 08-22 PENGU restatement had moved 0.75% against it. Both prices are real quotes inside the 04:30 5m bar, so nothing was fabricated and neither ALERT test fires; but only one can be the true fill, the trade log is not append-only, and hypecrypto_state.json still has no 'restatement' key. Severity raised to HIGH: it is now reproducible, mechanism-identified, and has flattered a book. (2) THE DAY'S BEST EVIDENCE IS A CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT THE FLEET RAN ON ITSELF. Between 23:48Z and 00:15Z the lottery bot refused ENAUSDT SIX times through its LATE guard (15.3-16.7% off its 24h low against a +15% cap), then twice more on ROLLED OVER. At 00:12:39Z, between the fifth and sixth refusal, hypecrypto bought the same coin off the same Grok signal and lost 55.30. Same signal, same minutes, one entry filter, opposite outcomes. That is the cleanest measurement this project has produced. (3) hunter is through the 10% drawdown line at 895.89, and it got there by rotation rather than by market: BTC fell 1.6% and SOL 2.0% today while the book fell 4.45%, because the 'Outgunned' ranker bought SOL at 96.61 nine minutes before its 97.17 high. Still 145.89 above the R1 hard stop. Loop health is otherwise excellent: 124 fleet cycles in 24h, largest gap 14.5 minutes, all ten paper books 10.7-10.8 minutes stale and lottery 5.5 - no frozen bot. The GitHub Actions paper-trade-cycle path still cancels most of its own runs (21 of 25 in 24h) with a 117.7-minute gap 08-22 23:58Z -> 08-23 01:55Z, over the 90-minute rule and WIDER than yesterday's 105 - but the local loop committed cycles at 00:12, 00:26, 00:40, 00:53, 01:07, 01:20, 01:34 and 01:47 through that window, so operational effect is again zero.
